https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.headline: Up 26% in a week while the market rose 3.5%, from ¥29.5k to ¥37.3k
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask rose from ¥29,500 to ¥37,260 in seven days, and completed sales stepped up from ¥29.6k to ¥37.5k over the same stretch. Trading is up to 2.9 sales a day from 1.6, and 16 of the 20 cheapest asks are within 15% of the low.

Why: Likely a catch-up move or a bounce after a long slide, since the card is still half its ¥74k peak. Pikachu V CSR from the same set rose by about the same amount, so this looks like one bet on the set rather than a card-specific story. I found no news of a reprint or a new product for this set; the 30th-anniversary announcement I read names other reprints. Raw A is ¥20,000, so the slab is about 1.9x raw today (pokeca-chart's own premium reading is from 9/21 and is stale).

For you: The ask is above the ¥37,000 ceiling and far above your ¥29,000 limit. Chasing it makes little sense; the Buy line is ¥31,000 and the correction rule needs ¥28,000.

Watch: Whether asks hold above ¥35k for another few checks. A move back toward ¥31–33k would reopen the Buy zone.
